4096 tokens is relatively high for LLM response generation. A token is approximately 0.75 words in English, so 4096 tokens represents roughly 3000-3500 words of generated text.

Reducing this limit depends on your specific needs:

1. For most typical RAG responses: 1024-2048 tokens would be sufficient (around 750-1500 words)
2. For concise answers: 512-1024 tokens 
3. For very brief responses: 256-512 tokens

Considerations:
- The current implementation uses this limit in both synchronous and asynchronous response generation
- Your system uses a memory manager with a MAX_TOKENS of 4000, so keeping response generation similar makes sense
- Smaller token limits will reduce costs and latency
- Setting it too low might truncate important information

If cost and speed are concerns, 1024-2048 tokens would provide a good balance between comprehensive answers and efficiency. If you mainly need brief factual responses, 512-1024 would be appropriate.
